objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-service-creation-on-remote-endpoint
objects.description: The following analytic identifies the creation of a Windows Service on a remote endpoint using `sc.exe`. It detects this activity by analyzing process execution logs from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on command-line arguments that include remote paths and service creation commands.
